% TS_fu13_cost, note below the table. Generated by analysis/paper_assets_isc.py; do not edit.
Each ratio divides the median of the float32 arm by the median of the bfloat16 arm on the same platform (v6e float32 against the v6e, L4 float32 against the L4), per token bucket. Processes gives the two counts. Wall time is the median process wall time. Compiled memory is the device memory of the compiled model, and peak reservation is the allocator peak, recorded on the TPU only.
